answer_1.quote: Given a natural language question and the database schema, text-to-SQL parsing aims to generate a SQL query.

answer_2.quote: 1) Exact Match (EM): a prediction is deemed correct only if it is exactly the same as the ground truth ... 2) MacroAvg: The arithmetic mean of EM across all clients ... 3) MicroAvg: The total number of correct predictions on all the clients divided by the total test examples ...
